T: Green girl. Pink girl. One table.
D: Before Dorothy arrived, a green-skinned student and a bubbly blonde became unlikely friends at Shiz University.
P: Serve the snacks when Elphaba and Galinda dance at the Ozdust Ballroom.
S: Ozdust salmon blinis and beetroot hummus
the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, and pink beetroot hummus on crackers. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a snip of chives. Blitz 1 drained tin chickpeas with 1 cooked beetroot, 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth and bright pink. Spoon onto 16 water crackers and top with crumbled feta. Arrange both on a platter.
Avocado, peas, lime and mint blended, served with cucumber sticks
Avocado, thawed peas, lime juice and mint blitzed bright green with salt, served with cucumber sticks and crackers.
M: the dining hall at Shiz University

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice. Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill with the mixture. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley. Slice the chicken and spoon over the lemon butter sauce, with rice on the side.
Creamy arborio risotto stirred through with pea and spinach puree
Arborio stirred with hot stock for 20 minutes, peas and spinach blitzed in at the end with butter and parmesan until bright green.
W: Butter sponge layers, one tinted pink and one green
Vanilla sponge batter split in two, one tinted pink and one green, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with vanilla buttercream.
Small pink meringues, crisp outside and light inside
Egg whites whipped glossy with caster sugar and a drop of pink colouring, piped into kisses, baked at 100C for an hour, with raspberries.
K: Lemon juice and sugar with cranberry juice for colour, over ice
Fresh lemonade turned pink with a splash of cranberry and topped with raspberries.

steps.text: Thaw the peas, juice the limes and cut the cucumbers into sticks.
Blitz the avocado, peas, lime juice, mint and salt until smooth and very green.
Spoon into a bowl and serve with the cucumber sticks and crackers.
Heat the oven to 100C and line two trays.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.
Fold in a drop of pink colouring and pipe small kisses onto the trays.
Bake for an hour, then turn off the oven and cool the meringues inside it.
Serve with raspberries.

dishes.make_ahead: Blitz the peas and spinach puree up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; cook the risotto fresh

steps.text: Heat the stock, grate the parmesan and blitz the peas and spinach with a splash of stock until smooth.
Stir the rice in some of the butter, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time.
Stir through the green puree, the rest of the butter and the parmesan until bright green.

veg.make_ahead: Blitz the peas and spinach puree up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; cook the risotto fresh

steps.text: Heat the stock, grate the cheese and blitz the peas and spinach with a splash of stock until smooth.
Stir the rice in some of the butter, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time.
Stir through the green puree, the rest of the butter and the cheese until bright green.

ingredients.item: pink and green food colouring, a few drops of each

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175C and grease and line two tins.
Beat the butter for the cake with the caster sugar until pale, beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour.
Split the batter in two and tint one half pink and one half green.
Bake in separate tins.
Cool completely.
Beat the butter for the buttercream with the icing sugar and vanilla, then stack the cakes with it.

dishes.make_ahead: Stir the lemon juice, sugar, water and cranberry juice together up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; pour over ice and add raspberries just before serving

steps.text: Juice the lemons and stir with the sugar until dissolved.
Add the water and cranberry juice.
Pour over ice in four glasses and float a few raspberries on top.

Emerald City green risotto.veg: Creamy arborio risotto stirred through with pea and spinach puree

s.note: Avocado, peas, lime and mint blended, served with cucumber sticks
s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed peas, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and salt until smooth and very green. Spoon into a bowl and serve with cucumber sticks and water crackers. It is green, it is bold, and it is not sorry about it.

m.note: Creamy arborio risotto stirred through with pea and spinach puree
m.how: Stir 300g arborio rice in butter, then add 1.25L hot stock a ladle at a time for 20 minutes. Blitz 200g peas with 100g spinach and a splash of stock until smooth. Stir through the risotto with more butter and grated parmesan until bright green.

w.note: Butter sponge layers, one tinted pink and one green
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Split the batter in two, tint one pink and one green and bake in separate tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Cool and stack with vanilla buttercream made with icing sugar.

w.note: Small pink meringues, crisp outside and light inside
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a drop of pink food colouring. Pipe small kisses onto lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour, then cool in the oven. Serve popular and pink with raspberries.

d.note: Lemon juice and sugar with cranberry juice for colour, over ice
d.how: Mix the juice of 6 lemons with 150g sugar until dissolved, then add 1L cold water and 100ml cranberry juice to turn it pink. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and float a few raspberries on top.
